entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hello Alex... I'm calling because I need to return something. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm very sorry to hear that you're disappointed. I can certainly look into a return for you. To start, what specifically is the issue with the item?

It's the new cycling shoes I bought. I've been a loyal customer for years, and I saved up for these, but they're just... they're causing horrible blisters on my heels. I can't even ride for more than twenty minutes.

Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I understand the frustration. So I can best help, is it a technical fault with the shoe, or more of a sizing or comfort preference?

I think it's just the fit. I've tried everything, adjusting the cleats, different socks... nothing works. I just feel awful about it. I really needed this money, and now I have these expensive shoes I can't even use.
I understand completely. Let's see what we can do. Can I get your order number please?
Yes, it's VF88602. I just really hope you can help me.

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Pedal cycling shoes, delivered 29 days ago. Let me just check the policy here... Ah, great news. You are well within our 90-day return window for a full refund.
Oh, really? So I can get a refund? That's... such a relief. Thank you so much.

Absolutely. I've just processed the return authorization. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email on file right now. Just pack the shoes back in their box, attach the label, and you can drop them off. Once we receive them, the refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
That's perfect. You've really helped me out today, Alex. I was so worried.
I'm happy I could resolve this for you. Is there anything else I can assist with?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
